scope: Standalone workbench with empty initial volumes and user-provided existing local inference services; no bundled weights/private adapter. Failed development attempts were retained in isolated test projects.

real_generation.frame_observation: Red ceramic cup on a wooden table in the inspected output frames.

controlled_recovery.upstream: controlled HTTP service, not GPU inference

fixed_during_acceptance: Invalid JSON escapes in script output; bounded format repair preserves text.
Scene/prop-only storyboard rejected by character-only precondition.
Smoke tool selects Pika native resolution presets rather than custom-size flag.
Queued/absent tasks no longer send unnecessary interrupts.
LLM catalogue tests isolated from existing private service settings.
limitations: Existing inference services and user-supplied API workflows are required; model installation is not automatic.
No direct generic cloud video connector.
ComfyUI and IndexTTS independent authentication not implemented.
Read state and task completion do not certify visual or audio quality.
